phase: Phase 11: Scientific Reproducibility Pipeline & Manifest Audit

Gate_11A_code_integrity.criteria: Clean working tree, phase10-frozen tag exists, phase11 branch branched from frozen state, zero uncommitted modifications.

Gate_11B_environment.criteria: Software stack pinned (Python 3.12, PyTorch 2.11+cu128, CUDA 12.8, GCC 13.3) with explicit determinism vs reproducibility disclosures.

Gate_11C_dataset_provenance.criteria: Strict separation between training (tum_fr1_desk) and zero-shot test (tum_fr2_xyz), camera models, depth scaling, 5 seeds documented.

Gate_11D_reproduction.criteria: 3-tier testing operational (pytest 456 unit tests, 8 runtime tests, fast smoke test, reproduce_phase10.sh).

Gate_11E_artifact_integrity.criteria: Bit-for-bit SHA-256 match on all 14 Phase 10 artifacts and 5 frozen TwoHeadMLP checkpoints.

Gate_11F_documentation.criteria: Standardized 11-section README, primary results table, paired statistics, and explicit wall-clock latency disclosures (T_sched << T_opt << T_frame).
